description: This is a PHP source file defining the ModulesAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for listing and updating module configurations in an OrangeHRM system. It implements CRUD endpoint methods (mostly getAll and update) for managing module activation states, leveraging external services and traits, and documenting API schema via OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: ModulesAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for listing and updating system modules in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getModuleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ModuleService instance.

methods.name: getConfigurableModulesArray
methods.description: Returns an array of module names and their enabled status, combining predefined config and current system state.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Not implemented; raises exception when called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Not implemented; raises exception when called.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns the list of modules and their statuses as an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns an empty validation rule collection for 'getAll' endpoint.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates module statuses based on request parameters, invalidates caches, and updates mobile client status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update request body, ensuring correct boolean values for each module parameter.
